language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

Hi my name is Alec. Today I am going to a special place with my class.
We are going to a music centre to watch a music concert. I love music, and I hope you do too.
It looks as if there are some numbers mixed up. Let’s help the musicians by putting them in order.
Let’s list them from the lowest number to the highest number.
Just by looking at these numbers I can arrange them like this:
12 is the lowest number so it goes first.
then I see 25 and next 38.
oh, but there is 32 so that should come in between 25 and 38.
then after 38 the next highest number is 56
and last there is 78.

The field trip was wonderful! Now we are all getting on the school bus to go back to school.
I am now looking in my backpack and see that I have some boxes of raisin snacks left.
Let’s make an equation that helps us solve the word problem here. Sometimes this is helpful in order to find the answer.
I brought 5 raisin boxes, and I shared 3 with my friends.
How many should be in my bag? I look in my bag and there are 2.
If I started with 5 and I gave away 3 then the equation should have a minus sign in it. This equation would be: 5 – 3 = 2.
Now you try with the apples I found in my bag.
